observations.behavior: Documentation clarifies that notes are optional metadata accompanying ratings, not independent events.

observations.behavior: Changes the feedback note property from a numeric length to the actual string content.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog to record the actual user feedback text rather than just its length, potentially improving qualitative analysis of report dismissals and refunds.
